recommendation: Keep this core audit commit as-is. Future substantive changes to coding-purpose should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack rather than by reintroducing an extension definition into core.
issue_request: FHIR-25211 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested a common extension on Coding to indicate why a Coding is present, with an extensible bound value set.
initial_application: No FHIR-25211 source-changing commit was found in the core checkout, and current core source has no coding-purpose row in its active Coding extensions spreadsheet. The request was applied in HL7/fhir-extensions by commit 66176b77af5e49670075ec5591b2712f7c74c27a, which explicitly references FHIR-25211 and added StructureDefinition-coding-purpose.xml, ValueSet-coding-purpose.xml, and CodeSystem-coding-purpose.xml.
additional_context: The current FHIR Extension Pack checkout defines coding-purpose with canonical URL http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/coding-purpose, context Coding, value type Coding, and an extensible binding to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/coding-purpose; the value set composes http://hl7.org/fhir/coding-purpose. input/extensions-ig.xml includes input/definitions/* as resource input scope and describes the pack's global extensions as always in scope. Current core only retains coding-purpose OID registry lines in source/oids.ini; its active source/fhir.ini Coding extension spreadsheet does not include the extension definition. MnM minutes confirm the original 3-0-0 persuasive vote. Later FHIR-41460 was retracted/no-change and HTA-170 remains unresolved, so neither changes this core reconciliation.
reconciliation: No core source file was changed. The reconciliation is an empty external-repo audit commit because the authoritative Coding Purpose extension and its terminology artifacts are already present in the FHIR Extension Pack, outside the current core source checkout.

related_jiras.note: Adjacent Coding conformance extension approved in the same MnM meeting; it is already represented by an audit commit on the combined branch.
Later request to add "Preferred" to the Coding Purpose code system was retracted/no-change and does not require a current source edit.
Unresolved request to add defining-code to the Extension Pack code system; future external work, not current core scope.
